upload.title: He Traded a Red Paperclip for a House 📎 #shorts
upload.description:
In 2005-2006, Kyle MacDonald started with one red paperclip and kept trading up - a fish-shaped pen, a doorknob, a camping stove, a generator, a snowmobile, a recording contract, a year of free rent, an afternoon with Alice Cooper, a movie role - until, 14 trades later, he got a house in Kipling, Saskatchewan.
